subject: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification
body:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 15, 2026 at 9:08 AM
Subject: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

Team — sharing the proposed publishing plan for “Known Issues & Workarounds” as part of the Escalation Playbook v2 rollout.

Goal: Support has a curated set of validated workarounds to use during triage, and we publish a “safe-to-share” subset to public/help content where it reduces ticket volume (streaming reconnect guidance, 429 troubleshooting, etc.).

Proposed classification (applies per issue/page and per section within a page):
1) RESTRICTED: customer-identifying details, account configs, enterprise/private incident notes, internal-only tooling links, raw log snippets.
2) INTERNAL: internal diagnostics, dashboards, oncall links, runbook-only steps, anything that could be misused or creates incorrect expectations.
3) SAFE-TO-SHARE: customer-facing symptoms + mitigations that are accurate across tiers and don’t expose internal/security details.

Review checklist (attached draft):
- Scope tags: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; region; model family; runtime version (if relevant)
- “Validated workaround” checkbox: Support Eng sign-off required (Priya/Owen)
- Customer comms: language avoids guarantees; points to the right SLA doc
- Security/Privacy: no IDs, no account identifiers; RESTRICTED sections remain internal only
- Escalation trigger: clearly states when to escalate to SRE / Private Deployments / Security
- Link hygiene: Confluence KB + public docs cross-link (if SAFE-TO-SHARE)

Initial publication set for week 2:
- Streaming disconnects & reconnect guidance (SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpt + INTERNAL diagnostics)
- 429 throttling & quota misconfig (SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpt)
- Dedicated latency spikes/noisy neighbor (mostly INTERNAL; small SAFE-TO-SHARE guidance on client timeouts + what to collect)
- Private SSO/SAML login failures (INTERNAL only initially; we can later publish generic IdP troubleshooting if Security agrees)

Timing:
- By Wed 2/18 EOD: Support Eng validation + classification sign-off
- By Fri 2/20: publish index + top 3 pages internally + push SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpts through docs PR

Asks:
1) Priya/Owen: confirm validation owners for each page and whether anything above should not be published externally.
2) Wei/Kira: confirm “public excerpt” ownership per product area (Hosted vs Dedicated/Private), and whether we need any additional gating language.
3) Dev: confirm this aligns with the escalation playbook rollout/training schedule.

Attachments:
- Known_Issues_Publishing_Checklist_v1.2 (Google Doc link)
- Known_Issues_Classification_Tags_v0.9 (Google Sheet link)

Thanks,
Elliot
—
Elliot Price
Director, Technical Documentation
Redwood Inference


From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 15, 2026 at 11:22 AM
Subject: Re: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

+1 on the structure.

Support Eng validation owners (proposed):
- Streaming disconnects: Priya (I can validate against SUP-4921 patterns + the new streaming panels once ENG-2844 lands)
- 429s/quota: Owen (ties to SUP-4922; also want to align wording with SDK guidance in python PR)
- Dedicated latency spikes: Priya + Owen jointly (we need to be careful: most “workarounds” are really “collect this + adjust autoscaling with support help”; I’d keep external language conservative)

Re: SAFE-TO-SHARE vs INTERNAL:
- Streaming: safe to share client-side reconnect + timeouts + what headers/fields to include in a support ticket (request-id, region, model, timestamp). Keep “root cause candidates” high level.
- 429: safe to share backoff/jitter + how to check quotas in Console. Keep anything about enforcement internals and burst knobs internal.

One add to checklist: “do we risk creating an implicit support commitment?” e.g., “we will increase quota in X hours” should never appear.

Priya


From: Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 16, 2026 at 8:14 AM
Subject: Re: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

Agree overall. A few flags on “safe-to-share” wording (learned the hard way):

- Avoid anything that sounds like “region failover is always OK.” For some enterprise customers it’s a compliance issue. Better: “if your org is configured for multi-region routing, consider…” and point to Support.
- For 429: include a small “what NOT to do” callout (no aggressive retries; respect Retry-After). This will reduce load and prevent self-inflicted incidents.
- For Dedicated latency spikes: I’m strongly in favor of keeping external guidance minimal until Tomáš finishes the runbook refresh + we can tie it to specific knobs that are supported. Otherwise we’ll get “we changed X and things got worse.”

Re: classification, can we standardize on a header block at top of every issue page?
- Classification: SAFE-TO-SHARE / INTERNAL / RESTRICTED
- Applies to: Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- Last validated: date + validator
- Related alerts/dashboards: (internal links)

I can take first pass on the “header block” template for the docs PR if helpful.

Owen


From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 16, 2026 at 10:03 AM
Subject: Re: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

This aligns with training week (week 4), but we need the internal pages live before we run scenario exercises.

Two items to incorporate:
1) Please add a step: “PM-613 approval required for anything SAFE-TO-SHARE that references product limitations.” I don’t want Support quoting something that Product wouldn’t stand behind.
2) For Private SSO/SAML: we should mark as INTERNAL for now. If we publish anything later, it needs Security + Private Deployments review and should be generic (no mention of specific IdP configurations, cert handling, etc.).

If the top 3 pages are ready by Fri 2/20, I’ll update the training deck links.

Dev


From: Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 17, 2026 at 1:37 PM
Subject: Re: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

+1 to keeping Private SSO/SAML INTERNAL-only for this sprint.

For the internal KB page, can we:
- Include an “Info to collect” section that Support can ask without pulling sensitive configs into email (e.g., “IdP change date/time; error code; whether SCIM is enabled; Private control plane version; screenshots OK but keep them in RESTRICTED ticket attachments”).
- Add a hard line: “Do not request IdP private keys or full SAML assertions over email/Slack.” (We still see this sometimes.)
- Explicitly route: first stop Support Eng; then Private Deployments; loop Security only if authentication changes suggest a security issue.

I can provide the “version/how to find” steps for Private control plane version + installer version.

Kira


From: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 9:05 AM
Subject: Re: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

For Hosted/public excerpt ownership:
- I’ll own the SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpt for streaming reconnect guidance + 429 troubleshooting.

Request: can we make sure the public excerpts are written to be SDK-agnostic but include a small “examples” section that links to SDK docs? We can keep the canonical retry guidance in the SDK repos.

Also: for streaming disconnects, I want to avoid listing too many “common causes” externally. We can say “network interruptions, client timeouts, or intermediate proxies,” but anything about specific edge components should stay INTERNAL.

Wei


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Owen Phillips <owen.phillips@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 4:27 PM
Subject: Re: Known Issues publishing plan (Escalation Playbook v2) — review checklist + classification

Locking plan based on this thread:

1) Standard header block (Owen draft) goes into every issue page:
- Classification + SAFE-TO-SHARE sections clearly labeled
- Applies to + tags
- Last validated + validator
- Escalation triggers

2) Publication set (week 2):
- Streaming disconnects: internal KB + SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpt (Wei owns excerpt; Priya validates)
- 429 throttling/quota: internal KB + SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpt (Wei excerpt; Owen validates; includes “don’t hammer retries”)
- Dedicated latency spikes: INTERNAL-only for now (Priya/Owen validate); we’ll add a small “what to collect” section that’s safe to share in tickets
- Private SSO/SAML: INTERNAL-only; includes Kira’s “do not request secrets” language + version collection steps

3) Approvals:
- Any SAFE-TO-SHARE excerpt that references limitations/commitments gets PM-613 approval (per Dev)

4) Handling rules:
- RESTRICTED content only in the support ticket system (attachments) and never pasted into Slack/email; Confluence pages must not include customer identifiers.

Next steps:
- I’ll update the checklist doc tonight and drop links in ENG-2841.
- Priya/Owen: please add your “validated” sign-off notes in the doc by EOD tomorrow.
- Wei: once we have the internal pages stable, I’ll open/refresh redwood-docs PR for public excerpts (ties to redwood-docs/pr_642).

Thanks all — this is exactly the level of specificity we need.

Elliot
